name: Agent Coding Standards CLI
description: Installs acs from SHA-256 verified upstream releases for amd64 Linux containers with glibc 2.38 or newer.

acsVersion.description: Stable CLI version in x.y.z format, without a v prefix. Requires upstream acs and SHA256SUMS.txt release assets. Independent of the rules version.

installDependencies.description: Install Git, CA certificates, curl and checksum/install tools using apt, dnf or microdnf. Disable only on pre-provisioned images.
